jp: いつものように谷で過ごしていたある日、それはどこからともなく聞こえてきたの。
jp_grezzo: "いつものように谷で過ごしていたある日、それはどこからともなく聞こえてきたの。"
en: One day, as I was spending my time in the valley as usual, the voice came to me out of nowhere.
en_grezzo: "One day, as I was spending my time in the valley as usual, the voice came to me out of nowhere."
it: Un giorno stavo nella valle come sempre, e quella voce è arrivata da chissà dove.

jp: すぐに谷の入口まで退避しろという声。動物たちが次々に逃げ出すのを見て、さすがに危険を感じたわ。動物たちを追って移動する途中、ふと振り返ると、谷の奥から黒い獣が湧いてくるのが見えたの。恐ろしかったわ…。
jp_grezzo: "すぐに谷の入口まで退避しろという声。動物たちが次々に逃げ出すのを見て、さすがに危険を感じたわ。動物たちを追って移動する途中、ふと振り返ると、谷の奥から黒い獣が湧いてくるのが見えたの。恐ろしかったわ…。"
en: It said that we must evacuate to the entrance of the valley as soon as possible. When I started to notice the local wildlife fleeing the area one after another, I knew we were in danger. As we started running after the animals, I turned my head and looked back to see a black beast emerge from the depths of the valley. It was terrifying...
en_grezzo: "It said that we must evacuate to the entrance of the valley as soon as possible. When I started to notice the local wildlife fleeing the area one after another, I knew we were in danger. As we started running after the animals, I turned my head and looked back to see a black beast emerge from the depths of the valley. It was terrifying..."
it: Diceva di ritirarci subito fino all'imbocco della valle. Quando ho visto gli animali fuggire uno dopo l'altro, ho capito che il pericolo era vero. Mentre li seguivo mi sono voltata un attimo, e dal fondo della valle ho visto scaturire una bestia nera. Che spavento...

jp: ここまで辿り着いた途端、空間が閉じて小さな裂け目だけが残ったわ。裂け目を覗くとね、谷の奥が見えるの。奥はもう、黒い獣でいっぱいよ。
jp_grezzo: "ここまで辿り着いた途端、空間が閉じて小さな裂け目だけが残ったわ。裂け目を覗くとね、谷の奥が見えるの。奥はもう、黒い獣でいっぱいよ。"
en: Right as we arrived here, the rift in space we passed through closed up, leaving only a tiny crevice. If you look through the crack, you can see that the depths of the valley are already swarming with those black beasts.
en_grezzo: "Right as we arrived here, the rift in space we passed through closed up, leaving only a tiny crevice. If you look through the crack, you can see that the depths of the valley are already swarming with those black beasts."
it: Appena siamo arrivati qui lo spazio si è richiuso, e ne è rimasta solo una fessura piccolissima. Se guardi dentro la fessura vedi il fondo della valle: ormai è pieno di bestie nere.

jp: ああ、こんな…！
jp_grezzo: "ああ、こんな…！"
en: Ohh, why...!
en_grezzo: "Ohh, why...!"
it: Ah, non è possibile...!

jp: こんな神秘を体験できるなんて！！私は今、猛烈に感動しているわ！！！
jp_grezzo: "こんな神秘を体験できるなんて！！私は今、猛烈に感動しているわ！！！"
en: What a fascinating, mystical experience I've had!! I'm moved!!!
en_grezzo: "What a fascinating, mystical experience I've had!! I'm moved!!!"
it: Poter vivere un mistero simile!! In questo momento sono commossa fino alle lacrime!!!

jp: お邪魔しました
jp_grezzo: "お邪魔しました"
en: Sorry for bothering you.
en_grezzo: "Sorry for bothering you."
it: Scusa il disturbo.

jp: 何が言いたい？
jp_grezzo: "何が言いたい？"
en: What do you mean?
en_grezzo: "What do you mean?"
it: Che cosa vuoi dire?

jp: …メシェラ……星を食らう巨人…風…おお儚き風……森の免疫…醜き森…醜きカラス………ありのままの姿…死…再生…破滅……終わりなき闇………白い鷹…白子……絶望…虚無…その先に何を見るのか………厄災…壊れ行く世界……ありのままの存在…
jp_grezzo: "…メシェラ……星を食らう巨人…風…おお儚き風……森の免疫…醜き森…醜きカラス………ありのままの姿…死…再生…破滅……終わりなき闇………白い鷹…白子……絶望…虚無…その先に何を見るのか………厄災…壊れ行く世界……ありのままの存在…"
en: ...Meshera...Star-eating giant...The wind...Oh, the ephermeral wind......Immunity of the forest...The hideous forest...The hideous crow......The way things truly are...Death...Rebirth...Ruin......Unending darkness.........The white hawk...Albino......Despair...Emptiness...What is it that we shall see beyond......Calamity...The crumbling world......That which truly is...
en_grezzo: "...Meshera...Star-eating giant...The wind...Oh, the ephermeral wind......Immunity of the forest...The hideous forest...The hideous crow......The way things truly are...Death...Rebirth...Ruin......Unending darkness.........The white hawk...Albino......Despair...Emptiness...What is it that we shall see beyond......Calamity...The crumbling world......That which truly is..."
it: ...Meshera......Il gigante che divora le stelle...Il vento...Oh, vento effimero......L'immunità della foresta...La foresta orrenda...Il corvo orrendo......Le cose come sono davvero...Morte...Rinascita...Rovina......Tenebra senza fine.........Il falco bianco...L'albino......Disperazione...Vuoto...Che cosa si vedrà, oltre.........Sciagura...Il mondo che si sgretola......L'essere qual è...

jp: …永遠の盟約……混沌…亡国の王子……忘却の女神……途絶えた運命…時空の管理者……忘れられない世界……妖精の伝える物語は………混沌の息子…世界記憶……アーカーシャの光…絆……最後の希望……続く開拓地……創出される世界……さいはてのうみ…
jp_grezzo: "…永遠の盟約……混沌…亡国の王子……忘却の女神……途絶えた運命…時空の管理者……忘れられない世界……妖精の伝える物語は………混沌の息子…世界記憶……アーカーシャの光…絆……最後の希望……続く開拓地……創出される世界……さいはてのうみ…"
en: ...Eternal pact......Chaos...The Apostle of Chaos......The Goddess of Oblivion......Lost destiny...Keeper of time and space......The unforgettable world......The story the fairies tell is......Son of Chaos...Memory of the world......Light of Arkasha...Bonds......The last hope......The continuing settlement......The world being created......The Farthest Sea...
en_grezzo: "...Eternal pact......Chaos...The Apostle of Chaos......The Goddess of Oblivion......Lost destiny...Keeper of time and space......The unforgettable world......The story the fairies tell is......Son of Chaos...Memory of the world......Light of Arkasha...Bonds......The last hope......The continuing settlement......The world being created......The Farthest Sea..."
it: ...Il patto eterno......Caos...Il principe del regno perduto......La dea dell'oblio......Il destino interrotto...Il custode dello spazio e del tempo......Il mondo che non si dimentica......La storia che le fate raccontano.........Il figlio del Caos...La memoria del mondo......La luce di Arkasha...I legami......L'ultima speranza......La colonia che continua......Il mondo che viene creato......Il mare in capo al mondo...

jp: …………(これ以上理解できない)
jp_grezzo: "…………(これ以上理解できない)"
en: ...........(You can't make sense of the rest.)
en_grezzo: "...........(You can't make sense of the rest.)"
it: ...........(Oltre questo non si capisce più niente.)

jp: 避難したほうがいい
jp_grezzo: "避難したほうがいい"
en: You should evacuate.
en_grezzo: "You should evacuate."
it: È meglio mettersi al riparo.

jp: 何を売っている？
jp_grezzo: "何を売っている？"
en: What do you sell here?
en_grezzo: "What do you sell here?"
it: Che cosa vendi?

jp: 焼き立てのパンが食べたい
jp_grezzo: "焼き立てのパンが食べたい"
en: I could go for some freshly baked bread.
en_grezzo: "I could go for some freshly baked bread."
it: Vorrei del pane appena sfornato.

jp: ラスキリスいらっしゃいませ。
jp_grezzo: "ラスキリスいらっしゃいませ。"
en: Welcome to Raskilis.
en_grezzo: "Welcome to Raskilis."
it: Benvenuti a Raskilis.

jp: 遺跡内でレベル110くらいの馬と青年に絡まれたって情報があった。どうやらイレギュラーって奴と間違えられて襲われたらしい。
jp_grezzo: "遺跡内でレベル110くらいの馬と青年に絡まれたって情報があった" + _na(3) + "。どうやらイレギュラーって奴と間違えられて襲われたらしい。"
en: I've received a report that someone got into a scuffle with young man and a horse around level 110 somewhere in the ruins. Apparently, the pair mistook him for someone named \"Irregular\" and attacked.
en_grezzo: "I've received a report that someone got into a scuffle with young man and a horse around level 110 somewhere in the ruins. Apparently, the pair mistook him for someone named \"Irregular\" and attacked."
it: Mi è arrivata voce che dentro le rovine un cavallo e un giovane sul livello 110 hanno aggredito qualcuno. Pare sia stato uno scambio di persona: cercavano un tale che chiamano l'Irregolare.

jp: そいつらも、そいつらが探している相手も名前は不明。も襲われるかもしれないから気をつけたほうがいい。
jp_grezzo: "そいつらも、そいつらが探している相手も名前は不明" + _da(3) + "。" + _kimi(3) + "も襲われるかもしれないから気をつけたほうがいい" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: Both of their names as well as the name of the person they're after are unknown. You'd better be careful, because you might their next target.
en_grezzo: "Both of their names as well as the name of the person they're after are unknown. You'd better be careful, because you might their next target."
it: Di quei due, e di chi stanno cercando, non si sa il nome. Potrebbe toccare anche a te, quindi sta' in guardia.

jp: 見える範囲にいると青年は精霊を召喚することがあるそう。煙幕を張ったり壁生成で視線を切ったりテレポートの杖で吹っ飛ばしたりするといいかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "見える範囲にいると青年は精霊を召喚することがあるそう" + _da(3) + "。煙幕を張ったり壁生成で視線を切ったりテレポートの杖で吹っ飛ばしたりするといいかもしれない" + _na(3) + "。"
en: I've heard that the young man may summon spirits when he's within sight. You might want to put up a smoke screen, use Wall Creation to cut off their line of sight, or send them away with rods of teleportation.
en_grezzo: "I've heard that the young man may summon spirits when he's within sight. You might want to put up a smoke screen, use Wall Creation to cut off their line of sight, or send them away with rods of teleportation."
it: Pare che il giovane, se ti ha a tiro, evochi degli spiriti. Può servire una cortina di fumo, oppure tagliare la linea di vista con la creazione di muri, o spazzarli via con una bacchetta di teletrasporto.

jp: 精霊どもはMPを減らす眼差しを向けてくるらしいから…やはり相手からなるべく見えないようにすると集中攻撃を防げる。
jp_grezzo: "精霊どもはMPを減らす眼差しを向けてくるらしいから…やはり相手からなるべく見えないようにすると集中攻撃を防げる" + _na(3) + "。"
en: I've heard that the spirits he summons will gaze at you to reduce your MP... so from the opponent's point of view, trying to avoid their gaze means that you won't be able to concentrate your attacks.
en_grezzo: "I've heard that the spirits he summons will gaze at you to reduce your MP... so from the opponent's point of view, trying to avoid their gaze means that you won't be able to concentrate your attacks."
it: Gli spiriti lanciano uno sguardo che consuma MP... quindi, di nuovo: stare il meno possibile nel loro campo visivo evita di prendersi tutti i colpi insieme.

jp: MPがどんどん減る魔漏状態にされると厳しいから、MPを回復できる魔力の巻物か杖を多めに用意しておくといい。
jp_grezzo: "MPがどんどん減る魔漏状態にされると厳しいから、MPを回復できる魔力の巻物か杖を多めに用意しておくといい" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: It's going to get tough being in a situation where your MP is constantly leaking away, so it's a good idea to prepare some scrolls or rods with magic that can restore MP.
en_grezzo: "It's going to get tough being in a situation where your MP is constantly leaking away, so it's a good idea to prepare some scrolls or rods with magic that can restore MP."
it: Se ti mettono nello stato in cui gli MP colano via di continuo sono guai, quindi conviene portarsi dietro parecchie pergamene o bacchette di mana per rimetterli a posto.

jp: ちなみに一番強いのは馬らしい。角に刺されると強烈な混沌の渦が発生することがあるらしい。襲われた奴はたまたま混沌耐性を高めていたから助かったものの、そうでなけりゃ余裕でお陀仏だったって話。
jp_grezzo: "ちなみに一番強いのは馬らしい" + _yo(3) + "。角に刺されると強烈な混沌の渦が発生することがあるらしい" + _na(3) + "。襲われた奴はたまたま混沌耐性を高めていたから助かったものの、そうでなけりゃ余裕でお陀仏だったって話" + _da(3) + "。"
en: By the way, the stronger one out of the two is apparently the horse. I heard that getting stabbed by its horn causes Chaos Ball to break out. The guy who was attacked just so happened to have a high level of resistance to chaos, so he managed to survive, but if he wasn't so lucky he would have perished in the end.
en_grezzo: "By the way, the stronger one out of the two is apparently the horse. I heard that getting stabbed by its horn causes Chaos Ball to break out. The guy who was attacked just so happened to have a high level of resistance to chaos, so he managed to survive, but if he wasn't so lucky he would have perished in the end."
it: A proposito: il più forte dei due pare sia il cavallo. Se ti infilza col corno può scatenarsi un vortice caotico coi fiocchi. Chi ha subito l'attacco se l'è cavata solo perché aveva alzato la resistenza al caos: senza quella, sarebbe finita lì.

jp: ちなみにどいつもこいつも混沌にはかなりの耐性があるみたい。
jp_grezzo: "ちなみにどいつもこいつも混沌にはかなりの耐性があるみたい" + _da(3) + "。"
en: I should also mention that all these guys have a fairly high resistance to chaos-attribute attacks.
en_grezzo: "I should also mention that all these guys have a fairly high resistance to chaos-attribute attacks."
it: E comunque, tutti quanti hanno una bella resistenza al caos.
